narrative.details:
The Kobolds in these parts sometimes carry Gold Dust on them.  I could really use the stuff - bring me a load of it and I'll give you the best price in town...best price in town!

You can find kobolds in the Fargodeep Mine to the south, and around the Jasperlode Mine to the northeast.
narrative.objectives: Bring 10 Gold Dust to Remy "Two Times" in Goldshire.  Gold Dust is gathered from Kobolds in Elwynn Forest.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thanks for the dust, adventurer. Here's your cash, and...here is a token from associates of mine. You might find it useful...useful.
narrative.requestItemsText: Psst! You have that Gold Dust for me...for me?
